review.summary: The new indexing operation needs an empty-result guard.

findings.title: Handle an empty record list
findings.problem: The code indexes the first item without checking whether the list is empty.
findings.why_it_matters: A request with no matching records raises an IndexError.
findings.trigger_scenario: The query returns an empty list.
findings.suggested_action: Handle the empty result before indexing and add a zero-result test.
